subject: Animation
title: The Toy Story Miracle
description: A 60-second lesson on The Toy Story Miracle.

hook.text: Disney nearly killed Toy Story halfway through production. They said the characters were unlikeable.

buildup.text: Disney's notes had pushed Woody into being a sarcastic bully. The story reels were painful to watch.

discovery.text: Pixar convinced Disney to let them rewrite the script their way. They rebuilt the film from scratch.

twist.text: The team worked around the clock for months. Several animators slept under their desks to meet deadlines.

climax.text: Toy Story opened to universal acclaim and earned $373 million, launching a new era of animation.

punchline.text: A film that nearly died became animation's future.

quiz.question: What crisis did Toy Story face during production?
options: The computer technology broke down completely
Disney nearly cancelled it because studio notes had made the characters unlikeable
